description: Source code for IPM console receiver driver in Zephyr RTOS, handling inter-processor communication and ring buffer management.

methods.name: ipm_console_thread
methods.description: Thread function handling incoming ring buffer data, printing messages, and re-enabling IPM channel if disabled.

methods.name: ipm_console_receive_callback
methods.description: Callback invoked upon receiving data via IPM, inserting data into ring buffer and managing interrupt enable state.

methods.name: ipm_console_receiver_init
methods.description: Initializes the IPM console receiver, binds to IPM device, sets up ring buffer, callback, and thread.
